# Third-party component

SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3 is used to read user-selected XLS, XLSX and CSV files locally in the browser.

- Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
- Documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/
- License: Apache-2.0, full text in `LICENSE.sheetjs` from https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/LICENSE

This parser contains no course case data. It is served locally; there is no runtime CDN dependency.
